text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Today is the final day of overseas training.
...Would it be a waste to simply visit the cafe I've grown accustomed to...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Mess-chan-senpa~i☆
Let's go out together!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I told you, that nickname is... 
Vivlos-san, are you getting carried away, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's the last day of training!
Our very last free time♪ Let's go, let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! I really wanted to see the show here♪
I'm so thrilled~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
They say a nearby cafe
is doing collaboration sweets too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However, did you not mention wanting to tour the castle interior as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If so, there will be no leeway before the starting time. Squeezing it in will be quite difficult.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm, then how about takeout? Wouldn't it be fine if we just drink on the move? Right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No. Apparently, if we are even one minute past the scheduled time, admission will be denied.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It would be tragic to go all that way only to be turned away over a few minutes. Therefore, let us give up on this cafe.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh, true enough~...!
Understood, main event takes priority...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, over here, over here!
We can't miss this theme park either!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: With its vast scale... normally, it would take an entire day to see. Considering the curfew, it will be quite demanding, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aw, but Messiah-san, who knows when we'll ever get to come here again?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: We might not get to savor every little detail, but don't you at least want to hit the highlights while we're here?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Just the main attractions at least! Oh, and the parade and the food...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You have completely abandoned any intention of holding back, haven't you? Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Very well. Then let us construct a time schedule.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'll go grab a park map!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, we're back~. I'm completely exhausted~~.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That is because you insisted on this and that, you know? In trying to fit everything in――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu, surprisingly, it all worked out somehow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, it turned into quite a fulfilling day.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Who was it that granted everything I wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So with that in mind, here!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: This is... a tablet case and... a letter?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for always thinking things through so seriously for me! Love ya so much♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you, always! For guiding me so much whenever I start darting off full speed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you from now on too! Mess-chan-senpa~i♡

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-san...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Like I said. 'Mess-chan' is what my siblings call me, and I have already told you it feels rather embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: But... yes. I look forward to our time together, my dear roommate.

After returning home.
I spotted Vivlos and Air Messiah at the airport.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? You aren't using the case yet?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I still have my current one, after all. I shall continue to use it for as long as it lasts.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It seems I will have plenty of use for it going forward, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Well, can't be helped then♪
